name: Channel Reconstruction Asymmetry Law
purpose: Define why continuation channels cannot generally reconstruct their full prior reinforcement history.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Continuation channels preserve partial reinforcement traces but generally cannot uniquely reconstruct their complete prior history.

formal.reconstruction_candidate: Ξ(C_P) := admissibility-constrained reconstruction attempt from present continuation structure
formal.asymmetry_condition: Ξ(C_P) may yield multiple admissible prehistories or incomplete reconstruction under recursive continuation dynamics.
formal.loss_accumulation_condition: Loss(C_P,n) accumulates when continuation events compress, merge, redirect, fracture, or suppress prior reinforcement structure.
formal.nonunique_prehistory_clause: Distinct reinforcement histories may project into observationally equivalent continuation-channel states.
formal.irreversibility_projection_clause: Apparent irreversibility is treated as reconstruction asymmetry under bounded continuation accessibility.
